messages.task:
You are a data-analysis assistant who can answer questions about CDW Corporation’s financial statement footnotes by invoking a set of helper tools.

Scenario description (context)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
CDW Corporation and its subsidiaries explained in their 2013 Notes to Consolidated Financial Statements that the denominator used to compute earnings-per-share was affected by common shares issued during both the IPO and the underwriters’ full exercise of the over-allotment option. Because the new shares were issued on July 2 2013 and July 31 2013, they are only partially reflected in the 2013 denominator and will be fully reflected in 2014.  The dilutive effect of outstanding restricted stock, restricted stock units, stock options and MPK plan units is reflected in the denominator for diluted EPS by applying the treasury-stock method.  A reconciliation of basic shares to diluted shares is provided (table omitted).  Additional narrative discusses deferred-compensation plans, redemption of senior subordinated notes, and other capital-structure changes, none of which alters how the dilutive share impact is calculated.

Available tools (callable functions)
---------------------------------------------------------------------
• list_all_security_types() -> List[str]
  Return the set of security types (e.g. “RSU”, “Options”, “MPK”) that may create dilution.

• list_years_with_impact_data() -> List[int]
  Give the years for which any dilutive-impact data are stored.

• fetch_dilutive_effect(year: int, security_type: str) -> float
  Retrieve the dilutive effect (in millions of shares) for a single security type in a single year.

• get_effects_for_security_over_range(security_type: str, start_year: int, end_year: int) -> List[float]
  Retrieve a list of yearly effects for one security type across a year range (inclusive).

• total_effect_for_year(year: int) -> float
  Sum the dilutive effects of all security types for the specified year.

• list_yearly_total_effects(start_year: int, end_year: int) -> List[float]
  Return the total dilutive effect for every year in the inclusive range.

• compute_average(values: List[float]) -> float
  Compute the arithmetic mean of a list of numbers.

• truncate_to_two_decimals(value: float) -> float
  Truncate (do not round) a float to two decimal places.

• get_weighted_average_shares(year: int) -> Tuple[float, float]
  Return the (basic, diluted) weighted-average share counts for a year (additional context, may or may not be needed).

• list_weighted_averages_over_range(start_year: int, end_year: int) -> Dict[int, Tuple[float, float]]
  Same data as above, but for a range of years.

Question you must answer
---------------------------------------------------------------------
What was the average effect, in millions, of the dilutive securities in 2012-14?

Use the tools as needed and provide the final numeric answer only.
